item.title: Justin Trudeau Helps Katy Perry Promote ‘Watch it Burn’ Single With Goofy TikTok Dance: Watch
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to our show, where we dive into the latest trends and news in the music industry. Today, we're talking about Katy Perry's new single 'Watch It Burn' and a very special endorsement from a notable figure - her boyfriend, former Canadian Prime Minister Justin Trudeau."
[Short music transition]
Host: "Katy Perry recently posted a TikTok video promoting her song, featuring Trudeau dancing along to the track. The clip shows Perry singing in a bus lot, before Trudeau joins in, bouncing around and showing off his moves. The video is a fun and lighthearted way to promote the song, with Perry even joking that 'ancient texts say that if you hop to this song you will get 1,000 years of good luck'."
[Short music transition]
Host: "Trudeau's appearance in the video is just one example of his 'supportive boyfriend duties' - a phrase he used to explain why he skipped a World Cup match to cheer on Perry's performance instead. The two have been dating since last summer, and have been making headlines with their public appearances, including a red carpet debut at Perry's Lifetimes Tour concert film premiere."
[Short music transition]
Host: "Perry has been open about her feelings for Trudeau, calling him 'the love of my life' and saying that he makes her feel 'really whole'. And with 'Watch It Burn' debuting at No. 38 on Billboard's Adult Pop Airplay chart, it's clear that Perry is still a force to be reckoned with in the music industry. She has 36 entries on the Billboard Hot 100 to date, including nine No. 1s."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "Thanks for tuning in to our show today. If you want to check out Katy Perry's TikTok video featuring Justin Trudeau, we'll have a link in our show notes. Until next time, keep on dancing - you never know, you might just get 1,000 years of good luck!"
